row.scim_plan: Organization Management add-on (or Enterprise Pro / Enhanced plans)
row.evidence: Docusign's SCIM guide requires 'a plan that includes Organization Management capabilities or ... the Organization Management add-on', and the Admin page lists SCIM management only under Organization Management, which needs Access Management with SSO; both are Contact Sales add-ons included in Enterprise Pro, while the pricing page marks Access management & SSO 'Contact sales' only.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Team price changed: Standard now shows $30/user/month on 'Annual | Billed monthly' ($360 annual commitment) vs June's $25; Business Pro $45, Personal $11. SSO is not on any self-serve plan (Access management & SSO: Contact sales on Enhanced plans). SCIM 2.0 (Organization Management) supports only Okta and Entra, each through a custom/non-gallery app; one connector per Docusign account with a non-expiring bearer token (two may be active). Deprovisioning closes the membership (set to DS Viewer, removed from groups) or closes the user when removed from the IdP. Permission profiles via the docusign:2.0 extension. The Okta OIN and Entra gallery Docusign apps use an older provisioning connector, not this SCIM. Admin API (user management) needs Docusign Admin on an enterprise account.

scim.plan: Organization Management add-on (included in Enterprise Pro)
scim.notes: Base URL is generated per Docusign account in Admin and not published as a pattern. Version inferred from the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:docusign:2.0:User schema. Organization Management requires the Access Management with SSO package, but the docs do not say SSO must be configured before SCIM; a claimed domain and a Docusign organization are required.

auth.token_source: Admin > Organization > Access Management > Identity Providers > User Provisioning tab > SCIM Provisioning > Generate SCIM Credentials

endpoints.notes: No SCIM API reference is published; Users and Groups inferred from the attribute and group-management guides.

operations.notes: active=true ensures an active membership exists (reactivation), false closes it. HTTP verbs not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Removing from the connector closes the account membership (set to DS Viewer, removed from all groups); removing the user from the IdP closes the user in all SCIM-managed accounts.

attributes.notes: phoneNumbers and the enterprise extension (employeeNumber, department, manager) are listed as 'Not supported'. preferredLanguage support is being removed.

roles.how: esignPermissionProfileName / clmPermissionProfileName extension attributes (permission profiles), set per user or group assignment in the IdP.

limitations.text: Only Okta and Entra are supported for SCIM.
Okta must use a custom connector; the OIN Docusign app does not have SCIM enabled. Entra needs your own (non-gallery) application.
Each Docusign account needs its own SCIM configuration and IdP connector.
Entra needs ?aadOptscim062020 appended to the Base URL.
SCIM-managed groups can only contain SCIM-managed memberships.

user_api.notes: Docusign Admin API; production use needs Docusign Admin on an enterprise account (Admin is an add-on to eSignature plans, included in IAM plans). Paths are prefixed /Management.

endpoints.purpose: Close a user's memberships (documented as DEL)
Delete user identities for an IdP (documented as DEL)
Add users to a DS group

rate_limits.text: 3,000 calls per hour per account by default, plus a 30-second burst limit.

okta.notes: OIN marks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push (page markup), but Docusign says the gallery app does not have SCIM enabled for Organization Management SCIM; kind left null.

entra.notes: Gallery app provisions users (no groups) through 'DocuSign's user account provisioning API'; Docusign's own SCIM guide requires a custom Entra app instead.

fallbacks.notes: JIT and bulk CSV actions are Docusign Admin (Access Management / Org Management) features.

conflicts.text: The Okta OIN Docusign page marks SCIM and Group Push, while Docusign says the gallery app does not have SCIM enabled and a custom connector is required.

open_questions: Price of the Organization Management add-on and of Enterprise Pro is not published.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees the paid seat is not documented.
No SCIM API reference: verbs, filtering, pagination and SCIM base URL pattern are undocumented.
Which provisioning protocol the Okta OIN and Entra gallery apps use (legacy connector) is not documented by Docusign.
